name: naoto24kawa-claude-plugins
description: Development process infrastructure, specification document generation, and exploratory QA testing plugins for development workflows

plugins.name: dev-process
plugins.description: Development process infrastructure plugin. Sets up CLAUDE.md rules, Issue/PR templates, GitHub Actions quality gates. Includes ECC pattern review, security review context, parallel expert review cycle, and process audit.

plugins.name: spec
plugins.description: Specification document generation, incremental update, and drift detection for codebases. Orchestrates 9 specialized sub-agents to produce system overview, architecture, data model, API, use cases, business rules, and non-functional requirements documents.

plugins.name: site-explorer
plugins.description: 任意の Web アプリに対して探索的テストを実行し、バグ・UI 不具合を自動検出して GitHub Issue に登録する汎用 QA エージェント
